name: What common bathroom layout problems can be fixed with a redesign?

mainEntity.name: What common bathroom layout problems can be fixed with a redesign?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom layout redesign can address issues such as poor traffic flow, limited storage, inadequate lighting, and inefficient use of space. Common problems include cramped shower areas, toilets placed in prominent sightlines, or sinks that are too small for daily use. A redesign can optimize placement of fixtures, add built-in storage, improve natural light, and create a more functional and aesthetically pleasing environment tailored to your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Redesign can fix poor flow, limited storage, bad lighting, and inefficient space use. It optimizes fixture placement and enhances functionality.
